evals.prompt: Design a brand theme for our customer portal. Brand colours: primary #2563EB (blue), background #FFFFFF, text #111827. The portal shows invoices and support tickets to customers. Apply to Website Theme doctype fields and produce a DESIGN.md with WCAG contrast checks.
evals.expected_output: Computed WCAG contrast ratios for primary/background and text/background pairs shown numerically. Mapping to Website Theme fields (primary_color, background_color, text_color pointing to Color docs). A DESIGN.md with SURFACE, AUDIENCE, FONT, PRIMARY, BACKGROUND, TEXT, WCAG AA, and IMPLEMENTATION rows. Note that Desk UI must not be overridden via Website Theme SCSS.
expectations: WCAG contrast ratio is computed numerically (not just claimed to pass)
Primary #2563EB on white background: ratio shown (~5.9:1, passes AA ≥4.5:1)
Text #111827 on white background: ratio shown (~16.7:1, passes AA)
Design direction maps to primary_color, background_color, text_color Website Theme fields
DESIGN.md produced with all required fields including WCAG AA row
Skill notes Desk UI must not be overridden via Website Theme SCSS

evals.prompt: Theme our frappe-ui SPA with brand colors: background #0F172A (dark navy), text #F8FAFC (near-white), accent #6366F1 (indigo). Compute WCAG contrast and give me the CSS variable overrides.
evals.expected_output: Contrast ratios computed for text on background and accent on background. CSS variable override block provided targeting --surface-white, --ink-gray-9, etc. with :root and [data-theme="dark"] sections.
expectations: Contrast ratio for #F8FAFC on #0F172A computed and shown (expected ~18:1, passes AA)
Contrast ratio for accent #6366F1 on #0F172A computed (expected ~4.7:1, passes AA for UI components ≥3:1)
CSS variable override block provided with :root and optional [data-theme="dark"] sections
Override placement instruction: place after all CSS imports in the SPA entry stylesheet
